tools.name: compare_to_competitor

tools.name: get_pricing_summary
tools.description: Return cloro's current pricing model: per-engine credit costs, the page-driven Google formula, and per-plan credit rates.

tools.name: list_engines
tools.description: List the AI engines and SERP sources cloro can query, with per-call credit cost and API endpoint.

tools.name: open_api_docs
tools.description: Return the URL to cloro's API documentation, which covers SERP scraping and AI model monitoring endpoints.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search cloro's blog for posts matching a query. Returns a small list of {title, url}.
